criteria_by_gate.R2: Six robustness criteria on Random Search, both assets, majority of 10 seeds (ADR 0013). Momentum re-baselined after the outer-fold leakage fix.
criteria_by_gate.R3: All six promotion criteria (positive net OOS return, bootstrap Sharpe CI excluding zero, survives doubled costs, beats buy-and-hold, survives dropping the top five trades, not confined to one fold) on Random Search, on both assets, on at least 6 of 10 seeds; plus a veto below 5 OOS trades (ADR 0015).
criteria_by_gate.S1: S1-B screened for mechanical viability only and could not reject on performance; the S1-C promotion criterion (same six, 6/10 seeds, both assets, plus deflated Sharpe > 0.95, PBO < 0.5 and BH at 0.05) was never executed (ADR 0016).
criteria_by_gate.S2: S2-B partial-signal trigger: positive compounded net OOS return on at least 2 of 3 seeds, at least 5 OOS trades on each such seed, and not confined to a single fold. It did not fire, so S2-C promotion was never authorised.

study.conclusion: Across the 13 strategy families the study tested, and against the 496,500 configurations actually evaluated to produce them, no family survives family-wise error control at alpha = 0.05; the probability of backtest overfitting is 0.486, and the probability that the best family is a product of selection rather than of edge is 1.000.

families.thesis: Opera ETH solamente cuando BTC confirma la misma dirección.
Si el precio rompe el máximo o mínimo de las últimas N horas, empieza un movimiento.
El flujo de órdenes compra pero el precio no acompaña: la divergencia se resuelve.
El funding alto indica exceso de largos apalancados; opera contra ese desequilibrio.
Los extremos de funding se corrigen: entra cuando el funding se dispara.
Un movimiento hecho con poco volumen es ruido y tiende a deshacerse.
Hay horas del día sistemáticamente mejores que otras.
Lo que se estira vuelve al centro: entra en contra del movimiento reciente.
Lo que ha subido sigue subiendo: entra a favor del movimiento reciente.
Solo actúa cuando varias escalas temporales (1h, 4h, diario) apuntan al mismo lado.
Cuando los compradores agresivos dominan de forma extrema, la presión se agota.
Igual que la ruptura, pero el umbral se mide en unidades de volatilidad actual, así que se adapta a mercados tranquilos y agitados.
El diferencial entre BTC y ETH se estira y luego vuelve.

regimes.conclusion: Across 65 testable family-by-regime cells, no cell survives multiple-testing correction within this exploratory block. The rejected families do not conceal an effect confined to high or low volatility, or to trending or ranging markets. The negative result is not an artefact of averaging across market states.
